reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread under their message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

That comes from Priyanka's posts in that channel on 2025-09-03. She said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so they could see all of this themselves.

There are no Tansley account files I can read, so I couldn't find a full address for the site, and my reply tells Tobias that.
